Prove your club has the most passionate fans!
Welcome to the world's biggest interactive virtual league.  Every time you earn XP playing FIFA 17 you contribute those points to your club.  A club's success in their league is based on the amount of XP their supporters generate for them on a daily basis.  
Clubs are placed in their appropriate leagues throughout the world, and the clubs with the most passionate FIFA fans will win their tables and earn promotion.  Teams with little support will finish near the bottom and face relegation.  Promotions and relegations will follow real world rules.  
Each season lasts a week.  The tables will constantly be changing each day and you'll need to make sure you contribute as much XP as you can to support your club and keep them from being relegated.
Contributing Points
The XP you earn is automatically contributed to the club you are supporting.  While you are contributing points to your club, so too are the millions of other FIFA 17 players across the globe.  
Scoring
Each day the clubs are ranked in order of their supporter's ‘Average XP Contribution'.  We add up the total amount of XP each club receives from their supporters and divide that by the number of supporters in the club to get the Average XP Contribution per member.  So, if a club receives 1,500,000 XP on Monday and has 1000 supporters they will have an average of 1500 XP.  
At the end of each day teams will be given points based on how they ranked that day.  The points are based on the number of clubs in each league.  So, the last place team gets 1 point, the second to last gets 2 points, third gets 3 points, and so on.  Those points are added up each day and the club that ends up with the most points at the end of the week wins the season.
Selecting Your Club
When you first booted up FIFA 17 you selected your favourite club.  That club is who you are supporting in the all new and exciting Support Your Club feature.  
If you would like to change your club you can do so in the EAS FC Support Your Club panel. The change won't take place until the next Support Your Club season begins on Monday, so you will continue to support your old club until the change takes effect.
You will only be able to change the club you support a limited amount of times.  So, choose carefully. 
Active Clubs
Each club will need to have a minimum number of supporters to activate them in the Support Your Club leagues.  If a club doesn't have enough fans they are still seen in the tables, but are unable to be promoted.  These teams will be indicated in red font and the number of fans needed to become eligible will be shown on the left hand side of the screen.
Rest of World
At any point you can go to a map of the world in the EAS FC hub and select a different league to see how the teams are ranked that week.
There will also be an all-time global leaderboard so you can see the top 99 teams across the globe in FIFA 17.
